title: Help getting RPG Maker VXAce's offline manual unlock to work.

posts.author: wbthehero
posts.body: SO I have this older windows xp era PC I like to use because it has a floppy disk and 2 dvd drives for uploading files, however I have been trying to get RPG Maker VXACE to work but since the PC does not have a wifi card and I do not have ethernet it will not let me put in my product key to activate it, When I tired the website for the offline manual unlock (I used the link on my phone) It showed that the link no longer works... Do you still have the ability to activate it offline or is there a different way to get it working?  (The PC is running Windows XP and Windows 7)

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you need to contact sales support on this website (link at top under support)
the company had changed website and name several times but they should still be able to handle it.
as for the original question in the title: Ace's help is of the officital filetype for helps (CHP if I remember correctly), and there are dozens of programs on the internet to convert CHP->PDF

would it be possible to activate vx ace on a diffrent pc and then transfer the unlock file to windows xp?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
there is no unlock file, it is stored in the registry somewhere.
but you can copy the help file, it's not copy protected after installation.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
wbthehero said:
what would happen if I copy the regertry as a hole?
Click to expand...
bad idea, because the registry also contains the settings for the drivers and the hardware. copying that to a computer with different hardware has a good chance of ruining your entire windows installation.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You may need to find a way to get an Internet connection.
You're trying to use 13-year-old software on a very specific obsolete hardware configuration - your options are going to be limited.
You know you can have both floppy disk and optical drives in computers with modern operating system, right?

posts.author: gstv87
posts.body:
the registry key only stores file paths and preferences, not the registration key.
I know because I too have a copy of that from when I changed computers.
I had the trial version and it defaulted to the standard paths, so I copied the paths from the registry of the old computer.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Sorry, I don't know what else to suggest.
On a more recent computer, you could install Steam and get VX Ace on there - it goes on sale several times a year for around the $5 range, as I recall.
Or do a search in your registry on the computer where it works, see if you can find the specific registry entry - but, honestly, if you've never worked at the registry level, that just might not be a safe option.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
wbthehero said:
I have one but when I try to activate it it pulls up a wepage that says "cannot display" and will not activate
Click to expand...
OK... it might be caused by not having 2 related Internet Explorer features enabled. You see, that activation window is an IE window in disguise. I only recall you need both 1.1 and 1.2 versions of the
TLS
protocol feature installed or enabled before activating your RM engine.
EDIT: It's called the
TLS
security protocol.
